headline: Trump's Russia Oil Deal Sparks Outcry; Nvidia Eyes AI Acquisition
summary: President Trump's proposed deal to buy Russian diesel drew sharp criticism from Ukraine, while a House Republican moves to block it. Nvidia is reportedly in talks to acquire AI startup Reflection AI, signaling continued M&A in the sector. Samsung Electronics posted record quarterly earnings, but its stock declined, contributing to a KOSPI drop.
